name: Kouklas Cafe
notes: 1 of 2 photos was the printed breakfast/food menu (transcribed); the other was a drink-price letter board (coffee/tea/smoothie prices only), skipped as drink-only.

dishes.name: French Toast
dishes.description: Brioche loaf, seasonal fruits, white chocolate mascarpone, maple syrup and powdered sugar.

dishes.name: Acai Bowl
dishes.description: Organic acai, fresh fruits, granolas, topped with peanut butter, nutella or biscotti.

dishes.name: Avocado Toast
dishes.description: Toasted sourdough topped with avocado, salt, pepper and a drizzle of balsamic glaze.

dishes.name: Eggs Your Way
dishes.description: Two eggs cooked your way, turkey sausage, and crispy tater tots.

dishes.name: Lahem Ajeen
dishes.description: Organic ground beef, bell pepper, onions, parsley and spices.

dishes.name: Zaatar Flatbread
dishes.description: Tahini, oregano, sumac, sesame seeds, lemon juice, salt & pepper, all mixed with extra virgin olive oil.

dishes.name: Shakshuka
dishes.description: Two eggs poached in tomatoes sauce, spiced with cumin, paprika & cayenne pepper. Served with homemade bread.

dishes.name: Breakfast Croissant
dishes.description: Croissant sandwiches with: cream cheese, smoked salmon & red onions; ham & cheese; or mozzarella, tomatoes, arugula & balsamic glaze.

dishes.name: Falafel Plate
dishes.description: Golden crisp on the outside and tender on the inside, served with your choice of hummus or salad and homemade pita bread.

dishes.name: Breakfast Tower
dishes.description: For 2 to 3 people: 4 eggs cooked your way, sopressata, grilled tomatoes, potatoes, avocado, olives, roasted sourdough, french toast and fresh fruits.

dishes.name: Bread & Spread Platter
dishes.description: Toasted sourdough bread, hummus, labneh, olives, avocado, za'atar, cream cheese and jam.

dishes.name: Slice of Cake / Cheesecake
dishes.description: Pistachio, Tiramisu, Crême brûlée, Lemon, Red Velvet, Mango, Matcha, Chocolate, Blueberries & More..!
